question: Exclude candidates whose SSI status cannot be verified with recorded reasons, or retain them as pending and hold the ordered selection?
basis: The handoff excludes demonstrably out-of-scope files but does not resolve treatment of historical corps badges whose file pages lack shoulder-sleeve-use evidence.
independent_work: Metadata cached for the first 300 ranks and scope/design reviews recorded for the first 160; only the accepted prefix is selected/acquired.
notes: Rank 82 needs alternate-size preview acquisition. Ranks 89/125 are standalone organizational band tabs; 130/146/153 need SSI versus other-insignia evidence. Later ranks 219 and 267 are also Spanish-American War corps-badge drawings, not yet reviewed.

external_research.result: Web lookup returned HTTP 403; no authoritative document body was obtained or relied upon to resolve the case. Search snippets are not treated as sufficient evidence.

user_decision.policy: Retain unverified SSI candidates as pending; hold the fixed ordered selection at the first unresolved candidate.
user_decision.selection_effect: No exclusions or substitutions added; 29 selected and acquired, first unresolved rank 35.
